The Chevron Panel Kids Bed brings geometric interest to a child's room with a V-shaped chevron headboard, curved side panels and a matching footboard, handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • V-shaped chevron panel headboard
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Rounded design with no sharp edges
  • Solid, sturdy wood frame
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. One price applies to all three sizes. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid, sturdy wood frame that is fully upholstered with rounded edges. Available in colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What does the chevron design look like?

The headboard has a V-shaped chevron pattern in the padding, with curved side panels to keep the shape soft.

What sizes does the Chevron Panel Kids Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT).

Does the bed have sharp edges?

No. It is fully upholstered with enclosed side panels and a rounded design, with no sharp edges.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free and usually takes 3-5 working days, as each bed is handmade to order.

What warranty does it have?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty.

Browse all kids beds or read our kids upholstered beds guide. Related: Line Kids Velvet Bed.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Cloud Teddy Bouclé Ottoman Bed is a soft teddy bouclé bed with hydraulic gas lift storage under the mattress, handmade to order by our family-run team in our Dewsbury workshop. It suits anyone who wants a cosy, textured bed and a place to keep spare bedding, towels and seasonal clothes out of sight, which helps in a bedroom short on wardrobe space. Sizes: Single 3ft £376.99, Small Double 4ft £402.99, Double 4ft6 £428.99, King 5ft £467.99 and Super King 6ft £532.99. Delivery is free across Great Britain to your door by our own team. Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and feel the bouclé at home first.

Good to know

  • Free delivery across Great Britain to your door (downstairs) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man: £90.
  • Room of Choice Drop Off: +£29.99. We carry it to the room you choose. Choose it under Delivery Service on this page.
  • Room of Choice Assembly: +£69.99. Optional room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99. Downstairs drop off stays free.
  • 14-day free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.
  • 5-year frame warranty.
  • Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout, or pay by card or PayPal.
  • Free fabric swatches: Order free fabric swatches before you choose a colour. Using your own fabric? We accept it and will confirm the fabric quantity for your size.

Key features

  • Soft teddy bouclé fabric upholstery
  • Hydraulic gas lift ottoman storage base
  • Large underbed storage space
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single (3FT): £376.99
  • Small Double (4FT): £402.99
  • Standard Double (4FT6): £428.99
  • King (5FT): £467.99
  • Super-King (6FT): £532.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Storage

A bouclé ottoman bed makes the most of the space under your mattress: the gas lift raises the base so you can store bedding, spare linen and seasonal clothes out of sight. Allow headroom above the bed for the platform to open.

Mattress compatibility

Choose the bed size that matches the mattress you plan to use. Our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress is available from £142.99.

Customisation

Teddy bouclé is the signature look of this bed, with other fabrics available on request. Order free swatches before you decide.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) to your door (downstairs) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

More ideas: browse all ottoman beds, compare with the Line Bumper Ottoman Divan Bed, or read how ottoman beds work. Love the texture? Our bouclé beds guide shows more.

FAQ

What is a teddy bouclé ottoman bed?

It is an ottoman bed upholstered in soft, textured teddy bouclé fabric, with a gas lift base that opens the storage underneath.

How does the gas lift storage work?

Hydraulic gas struts raise the base so you can reach the storage underneath. See our guide to how ottoman beds work.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

Is delivery really free?

Yes. Delivery to your door (downstairs) is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) and usually takes 3–5 working days from our own team. Northern Ireland delivery is £90.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Is teddy bouclé a good fabric for a bed?

Teddy bouclé is a soft, looped, textured fabric that gives the bed a warm, cosy look. If you would rather have a smoother finish, other fabrics such as Plush Velvet or Chenille are available on request. Order free fabric swatches to compare the feel side by side.

What size ottoman bed do I need?

Order the same size as your mattress: Single 3ft, Small Double 4ft, Double 4ft6, King 5ft or Super King 6ft. Leave headroom above the bed for the base to lift. Our UK bed sizes guide helps if you are unsure.

Will you carry it upstairs and build it?

Free delivery is to your door (downstairs) across Great Britain. Choose Room of Choice Drop Off (+£29.99) and our team will carry it to the room you want. Optional room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99. Both are picked under Delivery Service on this page.

Can I use my own fabric?

Yes, we accept customer-supplied fabric. Call or email us first and we will confirm the fabric quantity for your size.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.
